mayhem.title: ARAM: Mayhem
mayhem.intro: We're back with more content and balance changes for ARAM Mayhem! Four new Headliners are hitting the stage, bringing new ways to play. Whether you're looking for a second chance at life with Arcade, protecting your team with La Ilusion, getting rich with Debonair, or finding the perfect Augment with Maestro, we're excited for you to enjoy the show. We've also been keeping an eye on how the new set is playing out and listening to your feedback. Turrets have been falling a little too quickly, barely slowing down enemies and buying little-to-no time for their teams. We're experimenting with turret playing and increasing their defenses so games don't end in a blink. Tanks have had a particularly tough time keeping up with the chaos, so we're introducing four new tank-focused Augments to help our beefier champions stay in the fight. We're also making another round of champion balance adjustments to give some struggling picks a helping hand while bringing down a few overperformers. Finally, we're dialing back Bouncing Bees and Boom and the Bass, which have been putting out a little more damage than we'd like. As always, thank you for playing and keep the feedback coming!

On plate destruction, the tower gets a Bulwark buff that grants 60-80 resists per nearby champion.

mayhem.title: ARAM: Mayhem
mayhem.intro: Hello Superstars! This patch, we’re lowering the power of some new augments on the scene, buffing some survivability augments, and fixing a bunch of bugs. We’ve been monitoring the explosiveness of combat in the new update and want to alleviate some of the more frustrating situations. Fighters have become exceptionally good at closing out games and poke dominates early in the most recent update while tanks have been struggling. We’re aiming to bring down the power of some of the augments that have been making tanks feel so fragile like Take ‘Em Down Down Down and Weapon of Destiny. We’re also bringing up the power of survivability augments like Soul Eater and Stay Resolute. We're looking at overall burst and game pacing right now to make sure things don’t feel too snowbally. The stage crews have also finished setting up on Butcher’s Bridge and Koeshin’s Crossing so both of those maps will be back in the rotation with Headliner performances. With Worlds in full swing, the last page of the Journey to Stardom is now accessible. Complete all the missions and make your way to the Worlds stage to earn all the rewards! Two new augments are also joining the fray including one based on a classic World’s Anthem that’ll definitely make your enemies remember you. As always, thank you for playing and for all your feedback!

entries.name: Caitlyn
entries.summary: Caitlyn’s been at a very high pick and ban rate for most players for months now despite adjustments to other marksmen and the bot meta, so it's time to nerf her. We have felt that her late-game scaling has been too strong for a while now, so we’re moving some of her power from her eyepopping full build headshots into her early game Q damage to rebalance her power curve.

entries.name: Jinx
entries.summary: Like her best friend Caitlyn, Jinx has been similarly dominant in the meta, even with the Hurricane nerf last patch. We’re slowing her roll to make it a tad harder to get her snowballing.

entries.name: Lee Sin
entries.summary: Lee Sin has continued to be extremely popular since his adjustments to how his [W] Safeguard cooldown works with allies. While we like the extra flexibility that has given him, it's a bit too much power, so we’re nerfing the cooldown a bit along with a minor bug fix to how his E reveal works against invisible enemies and another small nerf to his [R] Dragon's Rage damage.

Some of those areas are his extremely generous mana tuning and ability to shrug off harass, and we’re also refining his power curve by improving his scaling damage slightly, because he falls off a bit too fast if he’s not able to close out games early.

entries.name: Nidalee

entries.name: Orianna

entries.name: Taric
entries.summary: We're smoothing out some of the rough edges in Taric’s kit to allow him to shine a bit more. Way back in the day, Taric’s W was adjusted to combat the popular Master Yi + Taric funnel strats. A consequence of this was that his spells would fizzle if they were cast at the same time that his bound ally became untargetable. We believe this harsh restriction to how his abilities function is no longer necessary given the existence of Role Quests, so we're partially reverting this change so that spells now work on untargetable allies, though we are still keeping an existing exemption on [E] Dazzle for champions that disappear on screen because the gameplay is too unclear (sorry, Master Yi).

mayhem.title: ARAM: Mayhem
mayhem.intro: Welcome to the latest ARAM Mayhem release - “Journey to Stardom”. The stars have certainly come out to play as each game of Mayhem will now feature a Headliner performance that applies a unique twist to the rules of each game. Each iconic band will be playing their music while you battle, so make sure you enable your sound and turn up the volume! STAGE CREW ANNOUNCEMENT: It’s taking a little longer to set up the concert stages on Butcher’s Bridge and Koeshin’s Crossing, so expect those maps to be unavailable in Mayhem queues for this patch but return next patch. Along with our Headliners, we have a TON of new augments for you to enjoy. With this release we’ll also be removing some augments and wishing them a fond farewell. But who knows? Completing these missions unlocks awesome rewards like Augments, emotes, orange essence, and more! entries.name: Ambessa
entries.summary: Ambessa has been too reliable in her late game output for players with high mastery in all brackets, but especially pro-play.

entries.name: Ashe
entries.summary: Ashe is one of the premier marksmen in pro play at the moment, and we're seeing her output too much raw damage given her position as the highest utility marksman in the game.

entries.name: Cassiopeia
entries.summary: Our changes two patches ago to Cassiopeia have been pretty good directionally, with most players being proportionally less impacted from those adjustments than pros. We're taking another swing at her early resources because of how dominant she still is in early laning, making her work a little harder to create an advantage.

entries.name: Diana
entries.summary: While Diana's assassin build shines, her bruiser builds tend to be lagging a good bit behind. We want to inject a bit more power into that playstyle.

entries.name: Kennen
entries.summary: Stacking the odds a bit more in his favor with his signature spell (in Riftbound) and offsetting Rocketbelt changes that he'll be a bit less excited about.

entries.name: Kindred
entries.summary: Kindred is currently a bit weak, so we're giving them buffs in areas that won't make them much more overwhelming in early invades. Optimistically, they'd also make a pretty unique addition to the meta.

entries.name: K'Sante
entries.summary: Warding off this warden from being as reliable as a blind pick in coordinated play - hurting early mana and consistent W damage reduction, which should be skewed for elite audiences.

entries.name: Lillia
entries.summary: Last patch we looked to inject a bit more power into the deer, but didn't quite see the movement we were looking for. We believe there is a bit more room for her to really prance around various levels of play so we are following up with another buff that'll really help her shine.

entries.name: Lucian
entries.summary: Last patch's adjustment to help normalize mid and bot performance ended up landing as a nerf for bot lane, so we're following up with a buff to make up for the lost power.

entries.name: Mordekaiser
entries.summary: Windows between Mordekaiser's ultimates make it hard to keep up with the pace of much of his opposition. His bread and butter (Q) can also feel less impactful as the pace of the game increases, so we think it can do more damage later on.

entries.name: Neeko
entries.summary: Rocketbelt's adjustment this patch will probably land as a small nerf for Neeko, so we're giving her some minor compensation

entries.name: Smolder
entries.summary: Smolder has lost quite a bit of power over the last few patches, with the Cleaver ranged nerf and bot lane meta changes disfavoring him significantly. We're further encouraging crit builds to bring his bruiser and full crit builds closer in power.

entries.name: Swain
entries.summary: We're giving Swain mid a moderate buff this patch while also making an adjustment that should help normalize his mid and bot lane performance.

entries.name: Tahm Kench
entries.summary: As one of the tank supports with the lowest health regen, and many health scaling values on his abilities, Tahm Kench lost out on the recent adjustments to the support item. We're giving him compensation for that.

entries.name: Vayne
entries.summary: Vayne has settled into a fairly weak spot, and while we still aren't totally happy with her top vs bot skew, we're getting closer. We're adjusting her base stats to help in bot where she needs to weather harass, and reverting a mana cost to her Q that simply felt way too bad.

entries.name: Yunara
entries.summary: Yunara is the leading candidate for "handshake hyperscaler do nothing" and we want to avoid that becoming the dominant meta, especially heading into worlds.

entries.name: Experimental Hexplate

entries.name: Hextech Rocketbelt
entries.summary: Rocketbelt continues to be used a bit too much as an escape compared to a risky engage tool, so we are pulling back on its generic value in favor of emphasizing aggressive action with it, especially for AP Bruisers who rely on it for all ins.

entries.name: Runaan's Hurricane
entries.summary: This item was slightly overbuffed, so pulling back on that a bit. Our recent systemic buff-bar clarity work moved a lot of numbers from buffs onto items. These numbers began terrorizing your scoreboards (thanks, Death's Dance). The scoreboard should show strategically relevant information, not noisy in-the-moment combat state, and we're hiding most item numbers on the scoreboard to reflect this principle. mayhem.title: ARAM: Mayhem
mayhem.intro: Hello Mayhemers! This patch, we're giving some champions and Augments that need a little love some extra attention. For champions, we're introducing champion-specific buffs that strengthen their core play patterns while also making them more accessible and satisfying to play in Mayhem. For Augments, we're continuing to focus on usability improvements. For example, Missile Split will now split when the missile reaches its end or is recast, rather than on the first target hit. We also lowered the cooldown on Triggered Inferno to show the real Samira fantasy. Let us know how these changes feel, and thank you for playing. See you on the Bridge!

entries.name: Aatrox
entries.summary: We think The Darkin Blade has lost a fair bit of power with Sundered Sky nerfs that were aimed more at opening up the jungle meta, so we are giving him a bump so he remains a world-ending threat.

entries.name: Aphelios
entries.summary: Aphelios has been kiting the spotlight for a while now, even though he's a hypercarry in an enchanter meta that should favor him, so we're looking to give him a little boost to encourage him to get out of his comfort zone.

entries.name: Aurora
entries.summary: Despite not receiving any changes since last year, Aurora has fallen off as we've had to nerf Rocketbelt into a fairer state. We're giving our favorite Bryni a bit more power in her waveclear and outplay potential with her ultimate.

entries.name: Draven
entries.summary: Since all bot laners received significantly increased gold income thanks to role quests, Draven's potential to gain a gold advantage through his Adoration stacks has lost some of its impact. We're giving him a helping hand (axe?) by tapping up his early game damage.

entries.name: Elise
entries.summary: This year started strong for AP junglers that could use Dusk and Dawn, but others like Elise have been in a weak spot for a while, so we are helping out our friendly neighborhood spider with clear speed and damage.

entries.name: Fiora
entries.summary: Our Grand Duelist has room to shine a bit more when she succeeds after finding her opening, without giving her sharper 1v1 tools.

entries.name: Kha'Zix
entries.summary: Kha'Zix has been on the fringe of the meta now that the jungle is no longer dominated by Sundered Sky users. We are taking this opportunity to buff some of his weaker evolves to give him the flexibility to adapt and overcome.

entries.name: Lillia
entries.summary: Lillia is on the edge of being viable at higher levels of play and we believe her current pattern requires her to get in danger's way, so we're helping her durability. We also want to give Lillia opportunities to really be a playmaker so we're making the enemies she lullabies a little extra sleepy.

entries.name: Lucian
entries.summary: Years ago, we added the Vigilance Passive so Lucian bot players didn't feel like their champ was being nerfed because of mid laners, which ended up being super effective. We think now is a good opportunity to adjust the tuning of the passive and strike a balance between both roles.

entries.name: Master Yi
entries.summary: Somewhat overdue, but because Duskblade was removed a while ago, we're removing the Ability Haste penalty we had to apply to his Q CDR mechanic. This should have minimal impact on Summoner's Rift, but we see you Mayhem and Arena!

lines.before: -1 second, scaling down with Ability Haste

entries.name: Nasus
entries.summary: Nasus is difficult to keep down these days, and part of that is how quickly getting his early stacks leads to more reliable stacking. These higher highs will be compensated with some lower lows through some more vulnerability early on with lower damage and lifesteal lane sustain values off of that, and a bit longer before he really comes online.

entries.name: Nocturne
entries.summary: Nocturne has been a popular and powerful jungler in both pro and solo-queue for a while, so we're hitting the map presence and dueling power he benefits from through his ultimate.

entries.name: Poppy
entries.summary: Poppy's flex potential and jungle presence has been a bit problematic, suppressing many champions across the board as a strong counterpick. For this change, we're targeting her flexibility by reverting a previous buff to jungle clear.

entries.name: Rumble
entries.summary: At higher levels of play, we've seen Rumble continue to take over games, even after our changes earlier this year designed to hit his power in lane. Here, we're making some modifications to his passive that's much more elite-skewed, while giving Rumble in the Jungle some compensation.

entries.name: Ryze
entries.summary: Between strong itemization options and best-in-class skirmish and roam potential demonstrated by his most skilled players, it's high time we put some restraints on the archmage, while giving him some help with bad solo queue matchups.

lines.text: Flux Bonus Damage: 25 / 50 / 75 / 100% increased damage ⇒ 15 / 40 / 65 / 90% increased damage

entries.name: Vi
entries.summary: Vi has been a meta staple for the entire year, and now that Sundered Sky is in a better spot, we're going after her durability and early clear speed to make her a riskier pick who can still bring the pain if you are willing to build for it.

entries.name: Volibear
entries.summary: This year we've been carefully buffing up AD Volibear, but he remains on the weak side even with his very unique AP build. We're tuning him up to help him out across both the fringe AD build and his core AP build.

rift.title: Items
rift.intro: We think melee supports have too much of their power in roaming and all-ins and are too weak in sustained laning. In response, we're shifting the flat health to health regen on World Atlas and Runic Compass, which will benefit them more due to their higher base health regen values.

rift.title: Systems
rift.intro: As the meta has continued to adjust to role quests, it's become clear that top lane is slightly weak, especially for split pushing. We're in turn buffing the cooldown of both the free role quest Teleport and upgraded Unleashed Teleport to promote those alternative strategies.

mayhem.title: ARAM: Mayhem
mayhem.intro: Hello Mayhemers! In this patch, we're focusing on bugfixes and small quality-of-life improvements. We're continuing to assess Augment offerings so that each Augment you're offered feels like a reasonable and meaningful option for your champion. For balance, High Roller has caught our attention for how powerful it can be when picked up early in the game. We're giving it another nerf to bring down some of that early snowballing potential. See you on the Bridge!

entries.name: 探险家 伊泽瑞尔
entries.summary: 伊泽瑞尔在今年的大部分段位表现一直不佳，尽管在职业赛场上依然非常热门。现在，随着职业赛季的结束，团队为他带来了一些增强，让他在你们的对局中表现得更出色。

entries.name: 正义巨像 加里奥
entries.summary: 加里奥最近有些乏力，团队想抽时间为他带来一些增强，特别是帮助他那些较弱的偏法强半肉流出装，而不仅仅是帮助他当前的高法强玩法。

entries.name: 迷失之牙 纳尔
entries.summary: 和伊泽瑞尔一样，纳尔可能是职业选手的上路热门选择，但在其他段位的表现并不理想，所以团队将加强他的投掷能力，助他一臂之力。

entries.name: 纳祖芒荣耀 奎桑提

entries.name: 诡术妖姬 乐芙兰

entries.name: 暗黑元首 辛德拉

entries.summary: 【电震涡流剑】在作为爆发和远程消耗型穿甲装备时都显得有些过于强势。爆发能力对刺客的作用比单纯的远程消耗更为重要，因此团队下调了其触发伤害。

mayhem.title: 海克斯大乱斗
mayhem.intro: 团队这次为海斗带来了更多内容和平衡性改动！四位全新赛季之星即将登场，带来全新玩法体验。无论你是想通过【比特狂飙】获得重生机会，用【彼岸灵花】守护队友，靠【执事乐队】发财致富，还是用【音乐大师】寻找完美强化符文，团队都期待你尽情享受这场盛宴。 团队也一直关注新赛季的表现，并倾听大家的反馈。现在的防御塔倒得有点太快了，几乎无法拖慢敌人，也没法为队伍争取到多少时间。团队正在尝试调整防御塔的玩法，并提升它们的防御力，避免比赛瞬间结束。 坦克英雄在混战中一直难以招架，所以团队将推出四个全新的坦克专属强化符文，让这些更为耐打的英雄能够持续奋战。团队还将对英雄进行新一轮的平衡调整，帮助一些表现不佳的英雄，同时削弱部分过于强势的英雄。最后，团队将削弱【弹跳蜜蜂】和【鼓声暴起 低音轰鸣】，它们最近造成的伤害有些超出团队的预期。 一如既往，感谢大家的游玩，欢迎持续反馈！

entries.name: 新增 坚不可破
entries.summary: 获得20护甲，然后额外护甲提高25%。

entries.name: 新增 秘术卫士
entries.summary: 获得20魔法抗性，然后额外魔法抗性提高25%。

entries.name: 新增 史莱姆时间
entries.summary: 每几秒，自动施放来自你身体的一团粘液，对附近的敌人们造成魔法伤害。如果你命中了一个英雄，则会分泌出一个液团，在你走上去时治疗你。

entries.summary: 获得额外护甲、魔法抗性和韧性。当你低于40%最大生命值时，该加成会提升。

entries.summary: 强化符文还会提供额外金币。

entries.name: 新增 彼岸灵花
entries.summary: 友军阵亡时会掉落一支蜡烛。拾取它即可为你和附近的队友提供护盾。

entries.summary: 从4个强化符文中进行选择。

entries.name: 防御塔镀层
entries.summary: 【海克斯大乱斗】中的防御塔现在拥有120护甲和120魔法抗性，且不会随着游戏进行而降低。 外侧防御塔和召唤水晶防御塔现在拥有防御塔镀层。镀层会将生命值条分为三段，每摧毁一层镀层，附近的队伍成员将平分100金币。当防御塔的镀层被摧毁时，防御塔会获得【壁垒】增益：每有一名附近的英雄，便获得60-80双抗。（注：经实测，不会因附近英雄的增加而获得更多双抗，将于后续版本修复）

entries.name: 铸星龙王 奥瑞利安·索尔
entries.summary: 大多数奥瑞利安·索尔玩家都明确表示，他们更愿意优先升级【星芒凝汇】(E)作为副升技能，而不是【星穹流丽】(W)，即使【星芒凝汇】作为副升技能要弱得多。团队同意他的(E)是一个非常酷炫的标志性技能，所以会加强它，帮助玩家把这个直观又有趣的操作变成最佳选择。

entries.name: 英勇投弹手 库奇
entries.summary: 进入全球总决赛时，团队在库奇的强度上较为谨慎，但现在(就像阿兹尔和奥莉安娜一样)，他还有提升空间，来对所有玩家都更加友好。

entries.name: 正义天使 凯尔
entries.summary: 自从今年早些时候游戏经历了上路任务的变动后，凯尔的重要性一直在逐渐下降。团队对她进行了小幅增强，帮助她更好地度过前期线上阶段，因为团队认为上路需要更多具备成长性的选择。

entries.name: 灰烬驱魔人 洛克
entries.summary: 虽然洛克整体表现尚属合理，但他展现出的深度远超团队最初的预期，已经掌握高阶玩法的玩家依然能让他表现得过于强势，尤其是在前期。

entries.name: 扭曲树精 茂凯
entries.summary: 茂凯今年一直非常沉寂，几乎完全被固定在辅助位置。团队会以对他进行加强，来让他在上路和打野两个位置都能脱离困境。

entries.name: 流光镜影 梅尔
entries.summary: 本次版本更新，梅尔将迎来一次中型调整。你也可以在这里阅读更多详情。简而言之，她的一部分强度将从前期转移到后期成长，她的W技能将全面更新为一个范围性投射物摧毁技能，会进行反击而不是反射，她的Q和R技能也会调整，后期冷却时间会降低，让她能够叠加被动到更高层数。

entries.summary: 在今年早些时候经历了一系列削弱后，纳亚菲利几乎已经完全退出了中路，在打野位的表现也相当平庸。团队将为她带来一次增强，应该有助于帮她在中路位脱离困境，让她的各位置强度更接近对等。

entries.name: 机械公敌 兰博
entries.summary: 和库奇一样，兰博也得到了针对职业赛场的调整。这个改动对普通玩家的帮助应该会比职业选手更大，等他们赶上版本更新后就能感受到。

entries.summary: 和茂凯一样，打野慎也已经过于远离战术格局。团队一直在关注前几个版本对打野坦克的帮助是否能让他回归，但现在团队有信心可以直接加强他了。

entries.name: 炽炎雏龙 斯莫德
entries.summary: 前几轮的加强效果比团队的预期要温和一些，但他现在的暴击和法术装备流派之间已经达到了不错的平衡，所以这次团队会给他一个更通用的加强。预计本次版本中【多兰之弓】的削弱也会对他有所帮助。

entries.name: 魂锁典狱长 锤石
entries.summary: 尽管团队之前削弱过锤石，但他依然稳居高端玩家辅助榜首，所以这次团队将再次对他进行调整。

entries.name: 奥术先驱 维克托
entries.summary: 上个版本对维克托的削弱比团队预期的影响更大——不过团队还算满意他前期压制力的降低，因此这次团队将提升他的后期成长能力。

entries.name: 疾风剑豪 亚索
entries.summary: 上个版本团队还在犹豫是否需要像削弱永恩一样削弱亚索。随着玩家转向暴击出装，亚索的胜率也持续上升，禁用率也是一样，所以这次他也会受到同样的调整。

entries.name: 不落魔锋 亚恒
entries.summary: 亚恒实现了他的大后期之梦，但他在线上还没有太多事情可做。下面的改动会让他前期的对拼和小规模战斗更有爽感。

entries.name: 多兰之弓
entries.summary: 团队对【多兰之弓】进行了小幅削弱，因为它目前的强度略高于预期，导致本应倾向于【多兰之刃】的射手直接毫不犹豫地选择它。

entries.name: 霸王血铠
entries.summary: 【霸王血铠】本应是顶级重装战士的终极装备之一，但除了瑟提之外，它并没有足够的强度让玩家愿意为其冒险。团队正在调整【霸王血铠】，这次改动对大多数其他使用者来说整体应该是一次增强，但团队同时也希望瑟提的强度不要提升过多。他的【蓄意轰拳】(W)与它的【报复】被动有很强的联动，所以他会是受益最大的英雄。

mayhem.title: 海克斯大乱斗
mayhem.intro: 各位超级巨星们好！本次更新团队将削弱部分新登场的强化符文，增强一些生存类强化符文，并修复大量BUG。团队一直在关注新版本中的战斗伤害爆炸情况，并希望缓解一些令人沮丧的局势。 战士在终结比赛方面表现得异常出色，而在最近的版本中，远程消耗英雄(俗称丢丢怪)主导了前期，坦克则一直处于劣势。团队计划削弱一些让坦克感觉过于脆的强化符文，例如【将他们放倒倒倒】和【命运之武器】。团队还将提升【吞噬灵魂】和【保持坚定】等生存类强化符文的强度。团队正在关注整体爆发和游戏节奏，确保对局不会让人感觉过于滚雪球。 舞美人员也已完成【屠夫之桥】和【莲华栈桥】的布置，这两张地图会携着巨星风采回归轮换池。 随着全球总决赛火热进行，巨星之路的最后一页现已解锁。完成所有任务，登上全球总决赛的舞台，赢取全部奖励！还有两个全新强化符文加入战局，其中之一灵感来自经典全球总决赛主题曲，绝对会让你的对手对你印象深刻。 一如既往，感谢大家的游玩和宝贵反馈！
